value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: the Oakville Costco isn't open yet, it's slated for 2027. The closest open one I found is Burlington, 1225 Brant St, (905) 336-6714. There's also a Laird Rd one in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd, though that address comes from a deals site, not Costco. I don't have driving times, so I can't say which is closer. Monday hours vary between listings, so I can't confirm Burlington is open right now.
